SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity"::INTEGER >= 200
    AND LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room');

    "name" AS "event_space_name",
    "event_space" AS "space_type",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity" = '200'
    AND LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room');

SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" ILIKE '%кафе%'
    AND r."cuisine" ILIKE '%итальян%'

UNION

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r;

                r."name",

                r."food_service"
FROM "restaurants" r

SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(s."role") = 'chef'

UNION ALL


SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(s."role") = 'server'
  AND LOWER(s."language") = 'english';

    s."id",
    s."name",
    s."role"
FROM
    "staff" s
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(s."language")) = 'english'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(s."role")) IN ('chef', 'server');

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    string_agg(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        it_support_specialists_systems itss
    JOIN
        systems s ON itss.system_id = s.system_id
    WHERE
        itss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;

112:
WITH internship_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total_internships
    FROM "internships"
),
responsibility_coverage AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS covered_internships
    FROM "responsibilities" r
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY r."responsibility"
)
SELECT "responsibility"
FROM responsibility_coverage
WHERE covered_internships = (SELECT total_internships FROM internship_count);

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs");
264:
SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
LEFT JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
266:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title,
    j."description" AS position_description,
    STRING_AGG(rs."skillname", ', ' ORDER BY rs."skillname") AS required_skills,
    STRING_AGG(er."degreelevel" || ' in ' || er."fieldofstudy", ', ' ORDER BY er."degreelevel") AS education_requirements
FROM
    "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN
    "jobskills" js ON j."jobid" = js."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "requiredskills" rs ON js."skillid" = rs."skillid"
LEFT JOIN
    "jobeducation" je ON j."jobid" = je."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "educationrequirements" er ON je."requirementid" = er."requirementid"
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs" WHERE "jobid" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY
    j."jobid", j."minimum_years", j."preferred_years", j."jobtitle", j."description";
